LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RootDesc: Choose a flesh cell where the psyphage roots and becomes a psyarchive. Rooting takes time; the psyarchive consumes a little hemogel and cannot move until it uproots.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RootNotFleshTerrain: The psyphage can only root into flesh.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RootUnreachable: The psyphage cannot reach this cell.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RootDisabledIncapable: The psyphage cannot move right now.
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_UprootDesc: Pull out the roots and become a mobile psyphage again. This takes time and is only possible while nothing is being digested.
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_UprootCancelDesc: Stop uprooting and stay in place.
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_UprootInterruptedDigesting: {0} stopped uprooting: something is being digested.
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_UprootWithersGrowth: The anima growth around it ({0}) will wither.
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_LinkRejectNotAccepted: only pawns accepted by the flesh colony
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_LinkRejectNoSpot: no free spot next to the psyarchive
LanguageData.FB_Psyarchive_LinkReadyText: {0} anima growth has grown around a psyarchive, enough for a colonist accepted by the flesh colony to link with it: they meditate next to it for {2}, gain a psylink level and use up {1} growth.\n\nSelect such a colonist and right-click the psyarchive to begin.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_Digested: {0} finished digesting {1}. New abilities in the archive: {2}.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_AbsorbedItem: {0} absorbed {1}. New ability in the archive: {2}.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectInorganic: Only living flesh can be digested.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectNotHelpless: The target must be downed, a prisoner, a slave or a colonist.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectNoAbilities: The target has no abilities to archive.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectTooInjured: The psyphage is too badly injured to swallow.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectTooLarge: {0} is too large to swallow (max {1} kg).
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectCapacity: Not enough room in the stomach: {0} + {1} of {2} kg.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectAmplifierNothingNew: The archive already holds every psycast.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_RejectSoulTreeAbsorbed: This psyphage has already absorbed an anima tree.
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageArchive_Empty: The archive is empty. Swallow a pawn with abilities or absorb a psytrainer to fill it.
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageArchive_SlotEmpty: Empty slot. Click an ability in the archive to copy it here.
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageArchive_SlotFilledHint: Click to remove it from the offshoot.
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageArchive_RowAddHint: Click to copy it into the offshoot, click again to remove it.
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageArchive_CreateDesc: Grow a psyoffshoot next to the psyphage. It can cast each ability in the slots once without psylink, psyfocus or neural heat, then withers.
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageArchive_ForgetConfirm: The psyphage will forget {0} for good. The ability can only return to the archive if it is absorbed again.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_OffshootRejectNoSlots: Copy at least one ability into the slots.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_OffshootRejectCooldown: The next offshoot can be grown in {0}.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_OffshootRejectIncapable: The psyphage cannot grow offshoots right now.
LanguageData.FB_Psyphage_OffshootRejectDuplicate: This ability is already in a slot.
